info.title: Helvetly API
info.description: The public part of Helvetly's API: clients, invoices, quotes, instalment plans, payments, expenses, documents, engagements, scheduled sessions, products, the books (periods, audit log, VAT return, ledger) and the key figures (reports) of one workspace. Authenticate with a personal API token (Settings → API & MCP): `Authorization: Bearer hvt_…`. A token's scopes name what it may do per resource, the operation's tag in lower case: `read:invoices` calls the GET operations tagged Invoices, `write:invoices` also the others; `read:*` and `write:*` cover every resource, and write implies read. Anything else answers 403 token_scope. The token acts as its person with their live role and permissions, in the token's workspace, and works only while that person's access includes API & MCP (else 403 forbidden). Amounts are exact decimal strings. Errors are `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}`. The workspace's plan sets its API requests a minute, reads (GET) and writes apart, shared by all its tokens (429 rate_limited). The same operations are tools on the MCP server at /api/mcp.

tags.name: Clients
tags.description: Customers and their contacts: the people and companies you invoice. Each client has a per-workspace number that is never reused.

tags.name: Invoices
tags.description: Drafts, issuing (gapless numbers), sending, the PDF with the Swiss QR bill, e-invoice XML, payments, refunds, corrections and reminders.

tags.name: Quotes
tags.description: Offers to a client: draft, send, accept or decline, revise, and turn an accepted quote into an invoice draft.

tags.name: Instalments
tags.description: Paying an invoice in parts: a plan that issues one partial invoice per instalment, with pause, resume and cancel.

tags.name: Expenses
tags.description: Costs and their receipts: drafts, booking into the books, voiding, and the categories they are filed under.

tags.name: Documents
tags.description: Files of the workspace: upload (SHA-256 deduplicated), folders, metadata, download, links to records and client shares.

tags.name: Engagements
tags.description: Committed work per client: one-off or recurring periods, a delivery log, and invoice drafts per period.

tags.name: Scheduling
tags.description: Sessions with clients: one-off and recurring, attendance and the requests clients send from the portal.

tags.name: Products
tags.description: The catalogue of products and services you put on invoices and quotes.

tags.name: Books
tags.description: Bookkeeping: closed periods, the hash-chained audit log, the Swiss VAT return, the double-entry ledger and self-billing agreements.

tags.name: Reports
tags.description: Key figures from actual invoices, expenses and payments.

get.description: Clients of the workspace, paged and filterable.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Matches name, number, email, city and more.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Contained in the name or preferred name (case-insensitive).

parameters.name: created_from
parameters.description: Created on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD) in the workspace's time zone.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: One of number, name, email, city, created_at, updated_at; prefix - for descending. Default -created_at.

post.description: Creates a client with the next client number. Only name is required.

get.description: One client with its contacts.

patch.description: Changes only the fields sent; null or blank clears a field.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the client: it disappears from lists and can no longer be fetched or edited (404), its portal sessions end, and its number is never reused. Issued invoices keep their buyer snapshot and stay creditable; nothing is deleted from the books. Only owners and admins may delete (403 forbidden otherwise). The record cannot be restored through the API, and a retry answers 404. 204 on success.

get.description: Invoices, credit notes and other documents of the workspace, paged and filterable.

parameters.name: unlinked
parameters.description: 1 for only documents not linked to an engagement.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Comma-separated: draft, open, paid, void, replaced, overdue, refund_due.

parameters.name: total_min
parameters.description: Total at least this amount, such as 100 or 99.50.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: One of number, issue_date, due_date, next_due_date, total, client, created_at; prefix - for descending. next_due_date uses the earliest open instalment when there is one. Default newest first.

post.description: Creates a draft (no number yet) for a client; totals are computed by Helvetly. Issue it with issue_invoice.

get.description: One invoice with lines, VAT breakdown, payments and the QR-bill reference.

patch.description: Changes a draft invoice; send only the fields that change (lines, when sent, replace all lines). Totals are recomputed. Only drafts can be edited: an issued invoice answers 409 invoice_locked (correct it with a credit note, or with correct_invoice), except that `reminders_enabled` alone may be changed on an issued one. A draft that is the source of an instalment plan answers 409 planned. 422 validation_failed with details.fields. Safe to retry: it sets fields to the values sent.

delete.description: Deletes a draft invoice for good; it never had a number, so no gap appears. Issued documents cannot be deleted (409 invoice_locked): void or credit them. A plan's source draft answers 409 planned. Answers 204. A repeat call answers 404.

post.description: Gives the draft its gapless number and freezes it. Cannot be undone: an issued invoice can only be voided or corrected. Answers 422 cannot_issue with details.reasons when something is missing. Answers 409 period_closed when the issue date's month is closed in the books, and 409 self_billing_agreement_missing for a self-billed invoice without a self-billing agreement covering the issue date.

get.description: Payments recorded against the invoice.

post.description: Records a payment received against an open invoice and answers with the updated invoice (status paid once nothing is due).

get.description: Expenses of the workspace, paged and filterable. Void ones are left out unless asked for.

parameters.name: total_min
parameters.description: Total, in the expense's own currency, at least this amount, such as 100 or 99.50.

parameters.name: total_max
parameters.description: Total, in the expense's own currency, at most this amount.

parameters.name: receipt
parameters.description: attached: expenses with a receipt file; missing: expenses without one.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: One of number, document_date, supplier, total, created_at; prefix - for descending. Default -document_date.

post.description: Creates a draft expense (source manual) with the next per-workspace number; every field is optional, so a half-filled draft is fine. Totals, the VAT breakdown and base-currency amounts are computed from the lines (exact decimals, one rounding per VAT rate). A draft is not final: finish it, add receipts and call book_expense. Duplicate warnings (duplicate_of) never block saving. 422 validation_failed with details.fields names every invalid field, 400 invalid_request an unknown field. Not idempotent: a retry creates a second draft.

get.description: One expense with its lines and VAT.

patch.description: Partial update of an expense: absent keys stay, null clears. A draft takes every ExpenseInput field (lines replaces all lines). A booked expense takes only the payment fields (payment_status, paid_on, payment_method, paid_by_member_id, reimbursed_on; a change is written to the audit log) and note; a void one only note. Anything else answers 409 expense_locked: void the expense and book a corrected copy (duplicate_expense). Changing a category used by booked expenses is not possible. 422 validation_failed with details.fields. Retrying the same body is safe.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a draft expense; it disappears from lists and cannot be restored through the API. Only drafts: a booked expense answers 409 invalid_state, void it instead (void_expense). Receipts stay attached to the deleted record. Answers 204; a retry answers 404.

get.description: Document metadata (name, size, kind, links), paged.

parameters.name: folder_id
parameters.description: A folder id, or root for the top level; empty for all.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Only documents linked to this client.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: File kind; repeat the parameter for any of several kinds.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Uploaded on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD) in the workspace's time zone.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Uploaded on or before this day (YYYY-MM-DD) in the workspace's time zone.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: One of name, size, created_at, updated_at, kind; prefix - for descending. Default name.

post.description: Uploads one file (multipart field file; one per request) into a folder (folder_id, default top level), optionally linking it to a client (client_id). Allowed types: PDF; PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF; XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV; DOCX, DOC, ODT, RTF; PPTX, ODP; TXT, Markdown, XML, JSON; ZIP; the extension and the file's bytes must agree, else 422 validation_failed (fields.file). Larger than DOCUMENTS_MAX_UPLOAD_MB (1 to 25 MiB, default 25): 413 payload_too_large. Names are cut to 255 characters and lose path parts. Duplicate check: the SHA-256 of the actual bytes is compared inside the workspace with live Documents (client files included). Identical bytes are never stored twice: the existing Document is the answer, 200 with {data: that document, reused: true}, whatever the name or on_conflict. It stays where it is (an unlocked top-level one moves into folder_id when sent) and is linked to client_id when sent. Only a caller who may not read Documents gets 409 duplicate_file. Bytes held only by an expense receipt are not a Documents duplicate: the file is stored as new. A same-named live file in the folder is a name conflict, resolved by on_conflict (fail: 409 name_taken with details {existing_id, suggestion}; keep_both; replace: the old file goes to the Trash, 409 retained if it is a business record); on_conflict applies only to different content. Repeating a successful upload answers 200 with reused: true.

200.description: An equal file already exists: that Document, with reused: true

get.description: One document's metadata.

patch.description: Renames and/or moves a live document (name, folder_id; null folder_id is the top level). A record file or a file under active retention cannot change folders (409 record_move_locked). A name taken in the target folder follows on_conflict: fail answers 409 name_taken (details.suggestion), keep_both renames, replace trashes the other file. 409 trashed for a document in the Trash (restore it with bulk_documents first), 422 validation_failed for a bad name or a folder that no longer exists. Retrying the same body is safe.

get.description: Committed work per client with the current period's usage. Default: scheduled and active.

post.description: Creates committed work for a client (a quantity per one-off or recurring period) and opens its due periods. Required: client_id, title, quantity, unit_price; a one-off (recurrence none) also needs end_date. Answers 422 validation_failed with details.fields (including a client, item or document outside the workspace). Not idempotent: a retry creates a second engagement.

get.description: One engagement with its current period.

patch.description: Changes only the fields sent. Once the engagement has entries or an advance invoice, client_id, start_date, recurrence and interval are locked (409 engagement_locked), and end_date cannot be before the latest entry. Open and upcoming periods follow a changed quantity or price unless they are invoiced in advance or were set by hand. Safe to retry with the same body.

delete.description: Deletes an engagement together with its entries. Cannot be undone. 409 engagement_invoiced when any period has an advance invoice or invoiced quantity: void those invoices first, or cancel it instead. Only owners and admins may do this (403 forbidden otherwise).

get.description: Products and services of the catalogue, paged.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.description: Comma-separated units: hour, day, piece, month, km, flat.

parameters.name: vat_rate
parameters.description: Comma-separated VAT rates in percent, such as 8.1.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Unit price at least this amount, such as 100 or 99.50.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Unit price at most this amount.

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description: with: items that have a SKU; without: items that have none.

parameters.name: updated_from
parameters.description: Last changed on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD) in the workspace's time zone.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: One of name, sku, unit_price, created_at, updated_at; prefix - for descending. Default name.

post.description: Adds an item to the catalogue. name and unit_price are required; type defaults to service and currency, VAT category and rate to the workspace's defaults. Prices are exact decimals. 422 validation_failed with details.fields (including sku when another active item already uses it). Not idempotent: a retry creates a second item (a repeated SKU is refused).

get.description: Streams the clients matching the filters (the same filters as list_clients, plus ids) as a CSV file, one row per client: number, name, preferred_name, type, active, draft, contact and address columns, tags joined by ';', the primary contact's name, created_at and updated_at. Text starting with = + - or @ is prefixed with an apostrophe against spreadsheet formulas. Not paged. Read-only; safe to retry.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Matches name, number, email, city and more.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Contained in the name or preferred name (case-insensitive).

parameters.name: created_from
parameters.description: Created on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD) in the workspace's time zone.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated client ids: export only these.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: One of number, name, email, city, created_at, updated_at; prefix - for descending. Default -created_at.

get.description: Every tag used by a live client of the workspace with the number of clients carrying it, most used first. Tags are compared case-insensitively. Use it to pick a value for the tag filter of list_clients.

post.summary: Add a contact to a client
post.description: Adds a person to the client. The first contact becomes primary; with is_primary true a later one takes over and the others are unset. A client has exactly one primary contact while it has any. 422 validation_failed with details.fields for a missing name or a bad email or phone; 404 for an unknown client. Not idempotent: a retry adds a second contact.

patch.description: Changes only the fields sent; null or blank clears role, email or phone (not name). is_primary true makes this contact primary and unsets the others; is_primary false on the current primary is refused with 422 (make another contact primary instead). Safe to retry.

delete.description: Removes the contact for good. If it was the primary contact, the oldest remaining contact becomes primary. A retry answers 404. 204 on success.

get.description: The files attached to the client (also shown in Documents), newest first. Use the id with download_client_file.

post.description: Attaches 1 to 10 files (up to 25 MiB each, 95 MiB of files per request; PDF, PNG, JPEG, WebP, Excel, Word, CSV or text, checked from the bytes) sent as multipart/form-data in files[]. The SHA-256 of the bytes is compared workspace-wide: a file already in Documents is linked to the client instead of stored again (the original name, uploader and id are returned, so retrying is safe); a top-level one moves into the Clients folder, and bytes held only by an expense receipt are stored as a new Document; two identical files in one batch are refused with 409 duplicate_file (details existing_id, existing_name, resource when you may see it). Nothing is stored when any file is refused. Other errors: 413 payload_too_large, 422 validation_failed on files (none, too many, too large, unsupported type), 404 unknown client. 201 returns the files in upload order.

get.description: Downloads the file. A 302 response redirects to a signed MEDIA_URL link or a presigned storage URL, valid for 5 minutes. Follow the redirect without the Authorization header. With no MEDIA_URL and S3_PROXY_DOWNLOADS enabled, the API returns the file bytes and their content type directly. Downloads are unmetered.

200.description: The file bytes (only when the server streams downloads).

302.description: Redirect to a signed media link or presigned storage URL, valid for 5 minutes.

delete.description: Moves the file to the Documents Trash (restorable there for 30 days). A file that is a business record linked to a booked invoice or expense is kept: 409 retained. 204 on success.

get.description: Active (not archived) items ranked for picking a line: SKU or GTIN equal, name prefix, name contains, then description matches; items in the given currency first. An empty q lists the most recently updated. Not paged: returns at most limit items.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search term over name, SKU, GTIN and description.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: A three-letter ISO code, e.g. CHF; items in it rank first.

get.description: Downloads the items matching the filters (as list_products, plus ids) as a UTF-8 CSV with a BOM: type, name, sku, gtin, unit, price_basis, unit_price, unit_price_net, unit_price_gross, currency, vat_category, vat_rate, status (active or archived), description, created_at, updated_at. Not paged. Read-only; safe to retry.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Active or archived. Ignored when ids is set.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.description: Comma-separated units: hour, day, piece, month, km, flat.

parameters.name: vat_rate
parameters.description: Comma-separated VAT rates in percent, such as 8.1.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Unit price at least this amount, such as 100 or 99.50.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Unit price at most this amount.

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description: with: items that have a SKU; without: items that have none.

parameters.name: updated_from
parameters.description: Last changed on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD) in the workspace's time zone.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated item ids: export only these.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: One of name, sku, unit_price, created_at, updated_at; prefix - for descending. Default name.

get.description: One catalogue item, archived ones included.

patch.description: Changes only the fields sent; null or blank clears an optional field. Changing vat_category away from S resets vat_rate to 0; the derived net and gross prices follow. Existing invoices keep their copied lines. 422 validation_failed with details.fields. Safe to retry.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the item; invoices keep their copied lines. Owner or admin only (403 forbidden). It cannot be undone through the API; a retry answers 404. Archive instead (archive_product) to hide an item reversibly. 204 on success.

post.description: Hides the item from pickers and the default list while keeping it for reference; unarchive_product reverses it. Owner or admin only. Archiving an archived item is not an error, so a retry is safe. Returns the item.
Makes an archived item active again. Owner or admin only. 422 validation_failed on sku when another active item took its SKU meanwhile. Restoring an active item is not an error. Returns the item.
Creates a new active item from the same fields, named "<name> (copy)", without SKU or GTIN (they must stay unique). Not idempotent: each call adds a copy. Returns 201 with the new item.

get.description: Every invoice matching the list filters (no paging) as a UTF-8 CSV with BOM: number, kind, type_code, status, client, dates, currency, totals, amount_paid, amount_due, refund_due, reference, sent_at. Cells that could run as spreadsheet formulas are prefixed with an apostrophe.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Comma-separated: draft, open, paid, void, replaced, overdue, refund_due.

parameters.name: credited_invoice_id
parameters.description: Only documents that credit or correct this invoice.

parameters.name: total_min
parameters.description: Total at least this amount, such as 100 or 99.50.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: One of number, issue_date, due_date, next_due_date, total, client, created_at; prefix - for descending.

post.description: Computes lines, VAT groups and totals of an InvoiceInput without saving anything: no draft, no number, nothing booked. It is a POST (so it needs a write-scoped token) but has no side effects and is safe to repeat. The answer is an Invoice with an empty id. 422 validation_failed with details.fields.

get.description: Open, overdue, paid and draft totals in one currency plus the last months, optionally for a client and a named period compared to the preceding one.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Three-letter ISO code. Default: the workspace currency.

post.description: Turns an open proforma into a draft invoice or prepayment invoice (kind). 409 invalid_state when the document is not an open proforma. Not idempotent: each call makes a new draft.

Creates a draft of a corrected invoice with the lines of an open or paid invoice that has no credit notes. Issuing it replaces the original (status replaced). 409 invalid_state when the invoice is not open or paid, has credit notes, or its prepayment is deducted. Not idempotent: each call makes a new draft.

Creates a credit note draft against an open or paid invoice, for chosen lines or (without lines) the whole invoice, and answers 201 with the draft. Nothing is booked until you issue it (issue_invoice), which can fail with 409 period_closed or, for a self-billed invoice, 409 self_billing_agreement_missing. 409 invalid_state when the invoice is not open or paid, or its prepayment is deducted; 422 validation_failed when the credit exceeds what is left to credit. Not idempotent: each call makes a new draft. Send {} to credit everything.

Creates an empty debit note draft that refers to an open or paid invoice (add lines with update_invoice, then issue it). 409 invalid_state for other statuses. Not idempotent: each call makes a new draft.

get.description: Every send_invoice email of the invoice, newest first, with recipients and sender. Dunning mails are not listed here (see get_invoice_dunning).
Whether payment reminders apply to the invoice, whether they are paused or switched off (workspace or client), the next step and its due date, and the notices already sent.

post.description: Stops automatic reminders for this invoice until resumed. Safe to repeat. Answers with the dunning status.
Lets automatic reminders for this invoice go out again. Safe to repeat. Answers with the dunning status.

Emails the next reminder (with its letter and the invoice PDF) to the client right away, whether or not it is due, paused or the client opted out; it counts as a sent step. 409 invalid_state when no step is left, the client has no email, or the step was just sent; 503 mail_unavailable. Sends a real email: a retry sends the following step.

get.summary: Download a sent reminder as PDF
get.description: The letter of a notice already sent, by its level (1-based); 404 when that level was not sent.

post.summary: Duplicate an invoice as a draft
post.description: Copies an invoice, proforma, partial, prepayment or self-billed document into a new draft dated today with the client's terms. Credit notes, debit notes and corrections cannot be duplicated, nor can invoices of a deleted client (409 invalid_state). Not idempotent: each call makes a new draft.

get.description: The structured XML of an issued invoice or credit note in the chosen format: xrechnung-ubl, xrechnung-cii (XRechnung), peppol (Peppol BIS UBL), ro-cius (RO e-Factura for SPV), ksef-fa3 (Polish KSeF FA(3), PLN only) or factur-x (Factur-X 1.0 / ZUGFeRD 2.x: the issued PDF as PDF/A-3B with the EN 16931 CII XML embedded as factur-x.xml, served as application/pdf; 409 einvoice_facturx_cmyk or einvoice_facturx_unsupported when the stored PDF cannot be PDF/A-3). The first export of a format archives the bytes (SHA-256 in X-Helvetly-XML-SHA256); later calls return the archived bytes unchanged. Answers 409 invalid_state for drafts, issued_elsewhere for imported invoices, and einvoice_* codes when data is missing (seller contact, endpoint, NIP, VAT categories). Synthetic validation only: the response carries X-Helvetly-Preview: true; check the recipient's requirements. Peppol delivery is not done by this call.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The XML profile, or factur-x for the hybrid PDF.

200.description: The XML file, or the Factur-X PDF.

post.description: Records one payment for the whole amount due (default: today, bank transfer) and answers with the updated invoice. 409 invalid_state when nothing is due or the invoice is not open; 422 validation_failed on paid_on/method; 409 period_closed when the month of the date is closed in the books. Not idempotent: a retry answers 409 once paid. Undo with delete_payment. Send {} for the defaults.

post.summary: Attach a file to a payment
post.description: Links a bank statement, payment confirmation or credit advice to the invoice's payment. Either upload a file (multipart field file; the rules, limits and duplicate check of upload_document apply), which is filed in the invoice client's Documents/<year>/Bank Statements folder (the payment's year) as a payment confirmation, or send document_id instead to link a live document of the workspace, which stays where it is. Identical bytes link the existing document: 200 with reused: true. While linked, the document cannot be moved or trashed (409 record_move_locked or retained). HR files, trashed files and other workspaces' documents are 422 validation_failed. A closed period does not stop it. Audited as invoice.payment_file_attached. Needs write access to invoices and documents.

200.description: An equal file already exists: that Document, linked, with reused: true

delete.summary: Unlink a file from a payment
delete.description: Removes the link between the document and the invoice's payment; the document stays in Documents and can be moved again. 404 when it was not linked. Audited as invoice.payment_file_removed.

Removes a recorded payment; the invoice reopens. Owners and admins only (403 forbidden). A financial record: the deletion is written to the audit log. 409 invalid_state when a refund was paid out of this payment (delete the refund first) or the invoice's prepayment is already deducted on a final invoice. 409 period_closed when the month of the date is closed in the books. Answers 204; a repeat call answers 404.

get.description: The invoice's PDF: the frozen original for an issued document, a live watermarked rendering for a draft, and the uploaded original (any content type) for an invoice imported as issued elsewhere. Add download=1 to get it as an attachment instead of inline.

parameters.name: download
parameters.description: 1 to send Content-Disposition: attachment instead of inline.

post.description: Records money paid back to the buyer out of the invoice's credit balance (a credit note larger than what was paid makes refund_due > 0). Answers with the updated invoice. 409 invalid_state when nothing is due to be refunded; 422 validation_failed on amount/refunded_on/method; 409 period_closed when the month of the date is closed in the books. Not idempotent: a retry records a second refund (and fails once the due amount is covered). Undo with delete_refund.

post.summary: Attach a file to a refund
post.description: Links a bank statement, payment confirmation or credit advice to the invoice's refund. Either upload a file (multipart field file; the rules, limits and duplicate check of upload_document apply), which is filed in the invoice client's Documents/<year>/Bank Statements folder (the refund's year) as a payment confirmation, or send document_id instead to link a live document of the workspace, which stays where it is. Identical bytes link the existing document: 200 with reused: true. While linked, the document cannot be moved or trashed (409 record_move_locked or retained). HR files, trashed files and other workspaces' documents are 422 validation_failed. A closed period does not stop it. Audited as invoice.payment_file_attached. Needs write access to invoices and documents.

200.description: An equal file already exists: that Document, linked, with reused: true

delete.summary: Unlink a file from a refund
delete.description: Removes the link between the document and the invoice's refund; the document stays in Documents and can be moved again. 404 when it was not linked. Audited as invoice.payment_file_removed.

Removes a recorded refund and restores the invoice's refund_due. Owners and admins only (403 forbidden). A financial record: the deletion is written to the audit log. 409 period_closed when the month of the date is closed in the books. Answers 204; a repeat call answers 404.

post.summary: Email an issued invoice, or mark it sent
post.description: Emails the issued document's PDF (with the client's e-invoice XML attached when the client asked for one, einvoice_format) and records a delivery; the invoice's sent_at is set. Drafts, void and replaced documents cannot be emailed (409 invalid_state); invoices imported as issued elsewhere cannot be sent (409 issued_elsewhere); 503 mail_unavailable when the server has no email. 422 validation_failed on to/cc/subject/message (details.fields). Overlapping sends or a changed expected_amount_due are refused with 409. A later send emails another copy. On 502 delivery_uncertain the mail server may have accepted the message; verify delivery before resending. Send {} to use the defaults. email false only marks the invoice sent (its PDF handed over another way): no email, no delivery, mail need not be set up; an invoice sent already keeps its first sent_at; 409 invalid_state for a void invoice. email false with sent false takes the mark back (sent_at cleared), refused with 409 invalid_state once the invoice was emailed.

Cancels an open invoice that has no payments or credit notes: Helvetly issues a full credit note against it (a proforma is simply closed). Owners and admins only (403 forbidden). Cannot be undone. 409 invalid_state when the document is not open, is a credit note, or has payments or credits (use create_credit_note); 409 period_closed when today's month is closed; 409 self_billing_agreement_missing for a self-billed invoice without a covering agreement. Send {} for no reason. A retry answers 409 invalid_state.

get.description: The append-only, hash-chained log of financial events (issue, payments, voids, period closing, ...), oldest first, paged by cursor. Only owners and admins may do this (403 forbidden otherwise). A member needs the settings permission.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The last seq read (meta.next_cursor of the previous page).

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Oldest first (the default) or newest first; with newest, cursor pages to older events.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Only events of one group: payments (payments and refunds), invoices (invoices, credit notes, instalment plans), expenses, approvals, books (closed periods), portal, employees (HR and payroll) or settings (anything else).

parameters.name: actor

get.summary: Export the audit log as CSV
get.description: The whole audit log as a CSV file (UTF-8 with BOM). Only owners and admins may do this (403 forbidden otherwise). A member needs the settings permission.

get.summary: Verify the audit log's hash chain
get.description: Recomputes the chain: ok is false and broken_at names the first seq whose hash does not follow. Only owners and admins may do this (403 forbidden otherwise). A member needs the settings permission.

get.summary: List the people in the audit log
get.description: Everyone with an entry in the audit log whose account still exists, by name: the values for the actor filter. Only owners and admins may do this (403 forbidden otherwise). A member needs the settings permission.
The agreements under which self-billed invoices may be issued in this client's name. A self-billed invoice needs one covering its date.

post.description: Records the client's agreement to self-billing from starts_on. 422 validation_failed with details.fields. Not idempotent: a retry adds a second agreement. Only owners and admins may do this (403 forbidden otherwise).

delete.description: Deletes an agreement. 409 invalid_state once issued invoices relied on it: it stays on record. Only owners and admins may do this (403 forbidden otherwise).

get.description: The list as a CSV file (UTF-8 with BOM), without paging. With ids every status is included. Same filters as list_engagements.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Comma-separated: scheduled, active, ended, cancelled. Default: scheduled and active.

get.description: Counts of active engagements and of those ending soon, under pace, in overage or with something to invoice.

post.description: Ends the engagement on a day (default: the end of the current period) and cuts its later periods. 422 validation_failed when cancelled_on is in the past or before the latest entry. Reversible with resume while the day has not passed. Safe to retry. Only owners and admins may do this (403 forbidden otherwise).

get.summary: List the entries of an engagement
get.description: The delivery log: work done, newest first, each with the invoice that covers it, if any.

post.description: Adds an entry (quantity, date, note, who did it) and answers it with its recomputed period. The date picks the period; 422 validation_failed when it is outside every period, in the future or outside the engagement. Not idempotent: a retry logs the work twice.

get.summary: Export an engagement's entries as CSV
get.description: The entries as a CSV file (UTF-8 with BOM), one row each, with their period and invoice.

patch.description: Changes only the fields sent. 409 entry_invoiced once an invoice covers the entry: void or delete that invoice first. Safe to retry.

delete.description: Removes a logged entry. Cannot be undone. 409 entry_invoiced once an invoice covers it.

get.summary: List the periods of an engagement
get.description: Every period, oldest first, with used, remaining, overage and the invoices made from it. Use a period's id for entries, invoicing and the report.

patch.description: Sets the committed quantity of one period by hand; later changes to the engagement's quantity no longer overwrite it. 409 period_invoiced when the period has an advance invoice. Safe to retry.

post.summary: Create an invoice draft for a period
post.description: Makes one invoice draft for the period (it is not issued: use issue_invoice). kind advance bills the committed quantity (advance engagements, once per period: 409 already_invoiced); kind usage bills the uninvoiced entries and marks them invoiced (409 nothing_to_invoice when there are none). Needs both write:engagements and write:invoices. Not idempotent for usage: a second call bills the entries not yet covered.

get.description: The service report (Leistungsnachweis) of a period as a PDF, rendered live from the entries.

parameters.name: download
parameters.description: 1 sends it as an attachment instead of inline.

post.description: Emails the service report PDF. Recipients default to the client's email address; 422 validation_failed when none is valid. 503 mail_unavailable when email is not set up. Cannot be undone and a retry sends the email again.

Creates a new engagement with the same terms and the same length, starting the day after the old one ends (or on start_date). 409 not_renewable unless the engagement is a one-off with an end date. Not idempotent: a retry makes another copy.

Clears the cancellation. 409 not_resumable unless the engagement was cancelled for a day that has not passed. The periods cut by the cancellation are opened again on the next read. Only owners and admins may do this (403 forbidden otherwise).

get.description: Busy times imported from the hosts' own calendars, without titles, in [from, to) (at most 100 days).

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: me, all (default) or member ids separated by commas.

get.description: The kinds of session clients may book, by name; archived=true adds the archived ones.

post.summary: Schedule a session or a series
post.description: Creates a one-off session or a series (weekly or monthly) and its sessions up to 400 days ahead. Counts once in the plan's monthly scheduled sessions (402 limit_reached). Answers the event, its first 20 sessions and conflicts as warnings. Not idempotent.

get.description: Sessions whose start is in [from, to) (at most 100 days; default today and the next 31 days), by start. Filter by host, client, engagement or status; to_mark=true lists past sessions still open (not marked attended or missed).

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: me, all (default) or member ids separated by commas.

parameters.name: to_mark
parameters.description: true: past open sessions to mark.

get.description: One session with its open request, engagement entries, invoice and the conflicts of its time.

patch.summary: Change a session or its series
patch.description: Partial change. For a series, scope says how far it reaches: this session (it becomes an exception; a new time makes it rescheduled), this and the following (the series is split into a new event; the sessions keep their ids), or all upcoming sessions (changed ones keep their own time; details.kept counts them; a rule change cancels slots that no longer exist). Closed sessions refuse: 409 occurrence_closed. A session that has started keeps its time: moving it or changing its length answers 409 occurrence_started (series edits skip started sessions). Conflicts come back as warnings. With dry_run true the answer is { data: SchedulingMovePreview } and nothing changes; decisions then say what happens to the sessions it lists.

post.description: attended or no_show (from the start on; 409 not_started before), or scheduled to undo. A session that counts logs an engagement entry, which needs write:engagements; an entry already invoiced cannot be removed (409 entry_invoiced). waive is for owners and admins.

Cancels the session on time or late (default from the cancellation policy: after the deadline it is late). A late cancellation counts on its engagement when the settings say so. scope following or all also cancels the series' later sessions (on time) and ends the series.

get.description: Clients' cancel, reschedule and booking requests, oldest first, with their session. Deciding on them is done in the app.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: me, all (default) or member ids separated by commas.

get.description: The Swiss KMU double-entry ledger, derived on read: balances per account and currency for the period (opening balance includes everything before from), plus the documents that could not be posted. A member needs the settings permission.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day. Default: 1 January of the current year.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day. Default: 31 December of the current year.

get.description: The Hauptbuch of one account in one currency: opening balance, lines and closing balance. A member needs the settings permission.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day. Default: 1 January of the current year.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day. Default: 31 December of the current year.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: ISO 4217. Default: the workspace's base currency.

get.description: The journal of from..to as a file for Banana (tab-separated .txt), bexio, Abacus or plain CSV. The header X-Skipped-Rows counts rows the format cannot hold. A member needs the settings permission.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day. Default: 1 January of the current year.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day. Default: 31 December of the current year.

get.description: The Buchungssätze dated within from..to, one balanced row each. A member needs the settings permission.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day. Default: 1 January of the current year.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day. Default: 31 December of the current year.

get.description: Closed months, newest first, and first_month, the month the books start in. Invoices, payments, refunds, voids and expense bookings dated in a closed month are refused with 409 period_closed. A member needs the settings permission.

post.description: Closes a month that has ended (workspace time zone): from now on records dated in it can no longer change (409 period_closed). Written to the audit log and notified to the other owners and admins. 409 conflict when it is already closed. Reversible only with reopen_period, which is audited. Only owners and admins may do this (403 forbidden otherwise).

get.description: Per month from..to: invoices issued and expenses booked with totals per currency, and the drafts dated in it, so a month can be checked before it is closed. invoices and expenses are null when the caller may not read them. A member needs the settings permission.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last month, YYYY-MM; at most 36 months from from.

post.description: Reopens a closed month so records dated in it can change again. The reopening and its reason go into the audit log and the other owners and admins are notified. 404 when the month is not closed. Only owners and admins may do this (403 forbidden otherwise).

get.description: The Ziffern of the MWST-Abrechnung for a period, from issued invoices and booked expenses, by the workspace's method and basis. Choose the output with format: json (default), csv, pdf (summary) or xml (the eCH-0217 V2.0.0 file for the ESTV ePortal; 409 cannot_export with details.reasons when the seller UID or figures do not allow it). Filing itself stays in the ePortal. A member needs the settings permission.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: A year (2026), half-year (2026-H1), quarter (2026-Q3) or month (2026-07). Default: the latest ended period of the workspace's settlement period.

200.description: JSON by default; a file for the other formats.

post.summary: Move, trash or restore documents and folders
post.description: The way to trash, restore and bulk-move documents (there is no DELETE on a document): up to 500 ids in total across document_ids and folder_ids, one action: move, trash, restore or delete. A move that would change the folder of a record file or a file under active retention returns 409 record_move_locked and rolls back the entire selection. Other item-level refusals are listed in skipped with a reason (not found, retained, name taken, folder moved into itself, not in the Trash); the call still answers 200. Trashing keeps an item for 30 days and is reversible with restore; a document linked to an issued invoice or a booked or void expense is a business record kept 10 years and cannot be trashed (skipped: retained). 422 validation_failed for an empty or oversized selection or an unknown action. delete removes items that are already in the Trash for good (owner or admin; anything else is skipped: not in the Trash); it cannot be undone, so trash first and delete only on an explicit request. Trashing the same items again is safe.

get.description: Every live folder of the workspace as a flat list ordered by name; build the tree from parent_id. Includes file counts and sizes.

post.description: Creates a folder (name, optional parent_id). Names are unique among live siblings, case-insensitively: 409 name_taken with details {existing_id, suggestion}. 422 validation_failed for a bad name or a parent that does not exist. Not idempotent: a retry answers 409 name_taken.

patch.summary: Rename or move a document folder
patch.description: Renames and/or moves a folder (parent_id null is the top level). 409 name_taken when a sibling has the name, 422 validation_failed when the folder would move into itself or one of its subfolders. Deleting a folder is done with bulk_documents (action trash).

get.description: Files and folders in the Trash, newest first. A trashed folder is listed once (its contents come back with it). Each entry shows purge_at: after 30 days it is deleted forever by a background job. Restore with bulk_documents (action restore). Emptying the Trash or deleting forever is not part of the public API.

Streams the file through the API with its stored content type (PDF and images inline, everything else as an attachment). Supports Range and If-None-Match (the ETag is the file's SHA-256; 304 when unchanged).

post.description: Makes an independent copy of a live document in folder_id (default the same folder; null the top level), named like keep-both ("Offer (2).pdf") when the name is taken. Links, shares and retention are not copied. An explicit copy is not an upload, so the duplicate check does not apply. 409 trashed for a trashed document. Not idempotent: each call makes another copy.

get.description: Downloads the document under its current name, including from Trash. A 302 response redirects to a signed MEDIA_URL link or a presigned storage URL, valid for 5 minutes. With no MEDIA_URL and S3_PROXY_DOWNLOADS enabled, the API returns the file bytes directly. Downloads are unmetered.

302.description: Redirect to a signed media link or presigned storage URL, valid for 5 minutes.

post.summary: Link a document to a record
post.description: Links a live document to a client, invoice or expense of the workspace (type, id). Linking to an issued invoice or a booked or void expense makes the document a business record kept for 10 years (it can no longer be trashed or deleted). Linking twice is a harmless no-op. 422 validation_failed when the record does not exist, 409 trashed for a trashed document. Answers 201 with the document.

delete.description: Removes one link (type client, invoice, expense or signature, and the target's id) and answers with the document. A link that makes the document a business record (retains true) cannot be removed: 409 retained. 404 when there is no such link.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Link type: client, invoice, expense or signature.

get.summary: List who a document is shared with
get.description: The clients the document is shared with: shared documents are visible to that client in the client portal.

delete.summary: Stop sharing a document with a client
delete.description: Removes the client's access to the document in the portal. The client is given as the query parameter client_id (a path segment is not possible here). Answers 204; repeating it is a no-op. 400 invalid_request when client_id is missing.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: The client to stop sharing with.

post.summary: Share a document with a client
post.description: Makes a live document visible to a client in the client portal (the client must be able to sign in to the portal). Answers 204; sharing again is a no-op. 404 for an unknown or deleted document or client.

get.description: The workspace's expense categories (each mapped to an account code), by account code; the Swiss KMU catalogue is created on first use, its names in the asker's language. Use an id as category_id on an expense. Creating and editing categories is a settings task in the app and not part of the public API.

Streams the expenses matching the filter (same filters as list_expenses, without paging) as UTF-8 CSV with a BOM, one row per expense, file name expenses-YYYY-MM-DD.csv. Columns: number, status, document_date, supplier, supplier_vat_number, supplier_country, reference, description, account_code, category, currency, net_total, vat_total, total, exchange_rate, exchange_rate_date, exchange_rate_source, base_currency, base_net_total, base_vat_total, base_total, input_tax, deductible_vat, base_deductible_vat, payment_status, paid_on, payment_method, paid_by, reimbursed_on, receipts, booked_at, created_at. Void expenses are left out unless status asks for them.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated expense ids: export only these.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Matches supplier, description, reference, supplier VAT number and the number.

parameters.name: incomplete
parameters.description: true: only drafts with missing fields.

parameters.name: total_min
parameters.description: Total, in the expense's own currency, at least this amount, such as 100 or 99.50.

parameters.name: total_max
parameters.description: Total, in the expense's own currency, at most this amount.

parameters.name: receipt
parameters.description: attached: expenses with a receipt file; missing: expenses without one.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: number, document_date, supplier, total, created_at; prefix - for descending. Default -document_date.

post.description: Runs the create rules and the computation on an ExpenseInput and answers with the expense it would produce (id empty, nothing written, no number used). Use it to check totals and VAT before create_expense. Same errors as create_expense.

get.description: Spending figures in the workspace currency: this and last month, unpaid, overdue, to reimburse, input VAT of the current quarter, incomplete drafts, this month by category and the last 12 months. Void expenses are excluded.

post.description: Books a complete draft: status booked, booked_at and booked_by are set, amounts freeze (GeBüV / OR 958f) and its receipts are locked against deletion (retention). Requires supplier, category, document date (not in the future), a total above 0, a receipt or a receipt_missing_reason, and for a foreign currency an exchange rate with date and source; otherwise 422 cannot_book with details.reasons (a list of sentences). 409 invalid_state if it is not a draft, 409 period_closed if the document date lies in a closed month. Writes an expense.booked audit event. Irreversible except by void_expense; a retry answers 409 invalid_state.

post.summary: Duplicate an expense as a draft
post.description: Creates a new draft from an expense of any status: same supplier, category, currency, VAT settings and lines; no date, reference or receipts, unpaid. Use it to book a corrected copy after void_expense. Not idempotent: each call creates another draft.

get.description: The receipt files attached to an expense, newest first (metadata only; download one with download_expense_receipt).

post.description: Attaches 1 to 10 receipts (multipart field files[], up to 25 MiB per file and 95 MiB of files per request; PDF, JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC/HEIF, checked by their bytes) to a draft or booked expense; a voided expense answers 409 invalid_state. Receipts added to a booked expense are retention-locked. All files are checked before any is stored: 422 validation_failed (fields.files) for a wrong type or size, 413 payload_too_large. Duplicate check: the SHA-256 of each file's actual bytes is compared inside the workspace. Bytes already in a live Document link that Document to the expense instead of storing a copy (201). Bytes already a receipt of another non-deleted expense answer 409 duplicate_file with details {existing_id, existing_name, resource: receipt, expense_id?} (details are left out when the caller may not read that resource). The same bytes twice in one request answer 409 duplicate_file with details {existing_name, resource: upload}, before anything is stored, and nothing from the batch is kept. Trashed documents and deleted expenses do not block. Another workspace never matches. Retrying a request that succeeded answers 409 duplicate_file (the receipt exists), so it is safe.

get.description: Downloads the receipt under its file name. A 302 response redirects to a signed MEDIA_URL link or a presigned storage URL, valid for 5 minutes. With no MEDIA_URL and S3_PROXY_DOWNLOADS enabled, the API returns the file bytes directly. With inline=1 the API serves the PDF or image directly with Content-Disposition: inline. Downloads are unmetered.

parameters.name: inline
parameters.description: 1: return the bytes inline instead of redirecting.

302.description: Redirect to a signed media link or presigned storage URL, valid for 5 minutes.

200.description: The receipt's bytes (proxied downloads or inline=1).

delete.description: Removes a receipt row and its file from a draft expense. A booked expense keeps its receipts (409 invalid_state, they are the evidence). The file is gone for good; answers 204, a retry answers 404.

post.description: Voids a booked expense with a reason (the correction path: void it, then duplicate_expense and book the corrected copy). Owner or admin only (403 forbidden for a member). 409 invalid_state unless the expense is booked, 409 period_closed if its document date is in a closed month. Writes an expense.voided audit event. Cannot be undone; a retry answers 409 invalid_state.

get.description: Instalment plans of the workspace, newest first, not paged, with each item's status.
One plan with its items. 404 not_found for an unknown plan or one of another workspace.

post.description: Cancels an active or paused plan: partials already issued stay as they are, the remaining items are never issued. Cannot be undone; writes an audit event. 409 invalid_state in any other status.
Pauses an active plan: nothing is issued until it is resumed. 409 invalid_state unless active.
Resumes a paused plan; items whose issue date has passed are issued on the next hourly run. 409 invalid_state unless paused.

post.summary: Plan a draft invoice in instalments
post.description: Splits a draft invoice into an instalment plan: one partial invoice is issued automatically per instalment, each on its own date, from the draft, which is never issued itself and is locked (409 planned on edit, delete and issue) while the plan exists. The draft must be an invoice, partial invoice, prepayment or debit note without prepayments or an instalment schedule. Each generated partial must have a positive payable amount. 404 for an unknown draft; 409 invalid_state when not a draft, already planned or it has a schedule; 422 validation_failed on kind, count (2 to 12), interval, first_due_date (not before today), lead_days (0 to 60); 422 cannot_issue (planned_with_prepayments) when the draft deducts prepayments. Not idempotent: a second call is refused with 409.

Creates a draft quote (no number yet) for a client; totals are computed by Helvetly. valid_until defaults to the issue date plus 30 days. Send it with send_quote. 422 validation_failed with details.fields on bad input. Not idempotent: a retry creates a second draft.

get.description: Quotes of the workspace, paged (page, page_size; meta has the totals) and filterable. Before paging was added this answered every quote at once; data keeps the same Quote objects, so a caller that needs them all reads page by page until meta.total_pages.

parameters.name: client_name
parameters.description: Only clients whose name contains this.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Comma-separated: draft, sent, accepted, declined, expired (expired is derived: sent and past valid_until).

parameters.name: total_min
parameters.description: Payable total at least this amount, such as 100 or 99.50.

parameters.name: total_max
parameters.description: Payable total at most this amount.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: One of number, client, issue_date, valid_until, total, status, created_at; prefix - for descending. Default newest made first.

delete.description: Deletes a quote that was never sent. Cannot be undone. 409 invalid_state once it was sent (decline or revise it instead); 404 when already gone.

patch.description: Changes the given fields of a draft quote; totals are recomputed. 409 quote_locked unless the quote is a draft (revise it first). 422 validation_failed with details.fields. A retry with the same body is safe.

get.description: One quote with lines and totals. 404 not_found for an unknown id.

post.description: Records that the client accepted a sent (or expired) quote, for an answer given outside Helvetly (the client can also answer in the portal). The answer is final: an accepted quote cannot be revised, only turned into an invoice with create_invoice_from_quote. 409 invalid_state unless sent or expired.
Records that the client declined a sent (or expired) quote. A declined quote can be revised into a new draft. 409 invalid_state unless sent or expired.

post.summary: Make an invoice draft from a quote
post.description: Creates one draft invoice (copying client, currency, language, VAT mode, discount, reference, intro, footer and lines) from an accepted quote; the answer is the quote with invoice set. Issue the draft with issue_invoice. Works once: 409 quote_invoiced the second time, 409 invalid_state unless the quote is accepted, 402 limit_reached at the plan's invoice limit.

get.description: The quote as a PDF. A draft is rendered live with a DRAFT watermark; otherwise it is the PDF of the last send.

parameters.name: download
parameters.description: 1 answers as an attachment instead of inline.

get.description: Every sent revision of the quote, newest first, each as it was sent: when and to whom, the answer it got (accepted, declined or expired, with the client's reason), the quote's content at the send (snapshot) and whether its PDF is stored. snapshot is null for revisions sent before revisions were kept. A draft that was never sent has none.

get.summary: Download the PDF of a sent revision
get.description: The PDF one revision of the quote was sent with, as stored: a redirect to a short-lived download link, or the bytes. 404 when the revision was not sent or its PDF is no longer stored (has_pdf false).

302.description: Redirect to a short-lived download link.

post.summary: Duplicate a quote as a draft
post.description: Copies any quote's client, lines, texts and payment schedule into a new unnumbered draft dated today, valid for as many days as the original. The original is unchanged. 409 invalid_state when the quote's client was deleted. Not idempotent: each call makes a new draft.

Turns a sent, expired or declined quote back into a draft of the next revision, keeping its number and clearing the answer; edit it with update_quote and send it again. 409 invalid_state for a draft or an accepted quote.

Sends a draft or sent quote. On the first send it gets its number (Q-<year>-<seq>), the PDF is filed and emailed to the client (default recipient: the client's email, else billing email); a sent quote is emailed again as it was. Sends a real email and cannot be undone; a retry emails again. email false only marks the quote sent without an email. The first send counts in the plan's quotes a month: 402 limit_reached when they are used up, and the quote stays an unnumbered draft; sending it again or a revision counts nothing. 409 invalid_state when expired (revise it) or already answered; 422 validation_failed for addresses, subject or message; 503 mail_unavailable when the server has no mail setup.

get.description: Outstanding, paid, overdue, spending, VAT to reclaim and cash flow in one currency.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: ISO code; default the invoice settings' currency, else CHF.

bearerAuth.description: A personal API token, hvt_…, with scopes such as read:* or write:invoices

Error.description: An error: 400 invalid_request, 401 unauthenticated, 402 plan_required or limit_reached, 403 forbidden, token_scope, token_not_allowed or feature_not_in_plan (the plan lacks the module; details: feature, plan, required_plan), 404 not_found, 409 conflict codes, 422 validation_failed, 429 rate_limited.

Money.description: An exact amount in major units with two decimals, as a string ("1234.50").

Quantity.description: An exact quantity, up to three decimals, as a string ("1.5").

Percent.description: A percentage, up to two decimals, as a string ("8.1").

Rate.description: An exchange rate, up to six decimals, as a string.

Meta.description: Paging of a list: page/page_size in, totals out.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code, e.g. not_found, validation_failed, token_scope.

avatar_url.description: The person's photo, empty when they have none.

roles.description: contact: billing and correspondence; participant: takes the service. A person client has no participants.

portal_enabled.description: A participant's own client portal switch; it follows the client's and the workspace's.

documents_to.description: Where a company's invoices and documents go: the company, or the participant each is for. Changing it never changes issued invoices.

portal_signed_in_at.description: When the client first signed in to the portal.

verified_uid.description: The UID (CHE-123.456.789) under which the Swiss UID register lists the client as active, checked when the client is saved.

uid_verified_at.description: When the Swiss UID register last confirmed verified_uid.

is_draft.description: True while fields an invoice needs are missing (missing_fields).

vat_number.description: Swiss UID (CHE-123.456.789) or an EU VAT number.

ClientInput.description: Fields of a client. Blank text or null clears a field; unknown fields are refused (400).

catalogue_price_basis.description: Original catalogue basis. Supply all three catalogue fields together to preserve the source price when editing a draft.

catalogue_unit_price.description: Original catalogue unit price before conversion, in catalogue_currency. The document still uses unit_price.

catalogue_currency.description: Currency of the original catalogue price.

documents.description: Linked files (bank statements, payment confirmations, credit advices), oldest first.

PaymentDocument.description: A file linked to a payment or refund.

file.description: A new file to store and link.

document_id.description: Instead of file: a live document of this workspace to link.

documents.description: Linked files (bank statements, payment confirmations, credit advices), oldest first.

status.description: credited: credit notes reduced the instalment to zero (they take from the last instalment backwards).

open_instalments.description: Instalments with an outstanding balance, in schedule order.

approval_state.description: A draft's approval before issuing, when its type needs approval: waiting, approved or rejected. Null without a request. Read only: approving happens in the app.

participant_contact_id.description: The participant of the client the invoice is addressed to (participants mode); null for the client itself.

quote.description: The accepted quote this invoice was made from.

client_number_display.description: The client number the PDF prints: null prints the client's own number, "" prints none.

contract_reference.description: The contract number (BT-12), printed as Contract no. and sent in e-invoices.

contract_document.description: The document of the workspace the contract is in; never printed. Null when none is linked or it is gone.

pdf_document.description: The document of the workspace holding this PDF (an imported invoice's original, else the issued or sent PDF filed in Documents). Null when there is none.

approval_state.description: A draft's approval before issuing, when its type needs approval: waiting, approved or rejected. Null without a request. Read only: approving happens in the app.

dry_run.description: Scope following or all of a series only: answer what the change would do (SchedulingMovePreview: how many sessions move, the first few, and each session that does not simply go along, with its reason) and change nothing.

decisions.description: Series edits: what happens to sessions the preview lists, by id. keep: stays where it is, off the rule. skip: cancelled on time. move_anyway: goes to its new time all the same (a day off the series skips, a conflict). with_series: changed on its own, moves with the others. move_to:<RFC 3339 instant>: goes to that time (not in the past). The dragged session goes where it was dropped unless decided otherwise.

scope.description: For a series: this session, this and the following (the series is split, ids kept), or all upcoming ones. A one-off ignores it. Default this.

SchedulingAttendanceInput.description: Mark attendance, or waive (owners and admins).

waive.description: On a no-show or late cancellation: it stops counting.

items.description: Sessions that do not simply go along.

moves_to.description: Its new start by the series' rule (its date moved by the series' days, at the new time), whether or not it goes there; null for started and closed sessions.

reason.description: started: has started, keeps its time. closed: attended, no-show or invoiced. exception: changed on its own, keeps its time (with_series moves it). day_off: its new day is a day off (moved there, or cancelled when the series skips days off). outside_series: past the series' end, cancelled. request_pending: the client's request is open. conflict: someone is busy then (see conflicts). monthly_rule: the rule repeats on a day of the month, which cannot move by days; nothing moves.

moves.description: A warning only: it moves unless decided otherwise.

conflicts.description: What its new time overlaps: the host's sessions (event) and calendar busy times (busy), the client's sessions with other members (client).

kept.description: Scope all: changed sessions that kept their own time.
